summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state (_thread_loop, _thread_id) initialised in __init__, set and cleared in the run_app coroutine's try/finally, and a CallThreadReturnType TypeVar. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 9 tests; all 9 pass on Python 3.9 when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at this repo's src. Five async tests in test_call_later, test_screens and test_unmount fail identically on the unmodified baseline (no async pytest plugin in the venv), so they are pre-existing and unrelated. Nothing was committed. Full test suite not run.
